contexts.text: Simeon means that [his mother] was less dear.
Simeon = faith in act.
Simeon represents the Lord as to spiritual things thence.
Exercise according to this truth (of faith) (being the second degree of the ascent) is signified by (the second son of Jacob by Leah), namely, Simeon.
Simeon named from He hath heard. AC 3869:end, Explained.
Simeon = faith of the will which is from the Lord.
Progress is made thence to will truth, which is Simeon.
Faith in the will is that which is signified by Simeon. AC 3869:2.
Under Hear, see this reference.
Will and affection contrary to charity are described by Simeon and Levi ().

She called his name Simeon () = the quality (of the successive, namely, of faith in obedience or in the will). This quality is what is signified by Simeon, and also by the tribe named from him; and this is the second universal of the Church, or when man is being regenerated; namely, obedience, or the will of doing the truth, into which charity (Levi) is implanted.
Under Levi, see this reference. AC 4515. AC 6352. AC 8093:2. AE 438. AE 443.
Simeon = faith; in the opposite, falsity... here, therefore () what is representative of spiritual things.
Under Judah, see this reference.
In the supreme sense, Simeon = Providence; in the internal, faith in the will; in the external, obedience.
Manasseh accepted instead of Simeon. Explained.
For Simeon = faith in act, or the obedience and will of doing truth, from which and through which is charity; thus the truth in act which is the good of the new Voluntary.

Let one of your brethren (Simeon) be bound () = that faith in the will shall be separated. (For) when faith in the will, or the will of doing the truth of faith, is separated from those who are in the truths of the Church, the connection with the Divine is (extremely) slight. Explained. AC 5482, Explained. AC 5526. AC 5538.
Faith in life and will is the faith represented by Simeon.

Simeon () = faith in the will, thus the good of faith; for when the truth of faith passes into the will, it becomes the good of faith; for the truth then passes into the man's life; and, when it is there, it is regarded not as what is to be known, but as what is to be done; from which it changes its essence, and becomes actual, and is no longer called truth, but good. AC 5630.
He brought Simeon out to them () = that he adjoined willing to truths. For Simeon = faith in the will, or the will of doing the truth which is of faith.
The sons of Simeon = faith in the will and its doctrinal things in general.

As Reuben and Simeon they shall be mine () = that they shall be truth and the good of truth... Simeon = faith in the will, thus truth in act, which is the good of faith, or the good of truth; thus, in general, the good which is of the new Voluntary.
When Manasseh was accepted instead of Simeon, there remained with Simeon the representative of faith in the will.
Simeon () = falsity in the will.
Reuben, Simeon, and their families () represent the things of faith.
The sons of Simeon = the things of faith in act. AC 7231.
Simeon and Levi here represent those in faith separated from charity.
The tribe of Simeon = the truth of faith in the life thence.

Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed 12,000 () = spiritual love, which is love towards the neighbour, or charity, with those who will be of the Lord's New Heaven and New Church. ( = obedience, and that all in it are in Heaven. AE 443.)
Simeon, in the supreme sense, = Providence; in the spiritual, love towards the neighbour, or charity; and in the natural, obedience and hearing.

Those in the Spiritual Kingdom are here treated of, whose love is called spiritual love, which is... charity. Simeon and his tribe represented this love, and signify it in the Word, because he was born after Reuben, and next before Levi; and Reuben, Simeon, and Levi = truth in the understanding, or faith; truth in the will, or charity; and truth in act, or good work: the same as Peter, James, and John.
As Simeon and his tribe represented truth in the will, which is both charity and obedience, he was named from hearing.

Those in and who come into the First Heaven, are signified by Simeon, etc. These are all in the obedience of doing truths and goods, which are the precepts in the Word, or in the doctrine of the Church into which they have been born, or are from a master or leader. Described.
The reason Simeon and his tribe = those in obedience, is that Simeon was named from to hear.
As Simeon = obedience, he also = faith; for faith is faith with man when he obeys the commandments... This faith which is obedience is signified also by Peter, when he is named Simon. (See Simon.)
In the opposite, Simeon and his tribe, = no obedience, and falsity in the will; and thence faith separated from the will, which is not faith. Illustrated.

But although Simeon and Levi were such, elsewhere they = the faith of charity, and charity... and therefore the tribe of Simeon, here and elsewhere, = obedience, the faith of charity, the affection of truth; and, in general, truth from good.
Simeon () = truth and good as to perception and obedience.
